messages:
elaine: Heads-up — we need to lock the design partner engagement policy and the minimum launch gates for the private preview. Trying to balance recruitment speed vs. meaningful feedback. Quick poll: do we require a short integration (0.5–1 day) before accepting, or accept lighter interest signals and pair later?
ryan: my vote is for 0.5 day integration + a test prompt set. weeds out low-signal partners early.
priya: +1. From a solutions perspective, the short integration helps us capture integration issues (auth, latency) that we won't see from docs alone.
sam: engineering note: if we require a working integration we should promise a supported minimal stack (SDK + recipe). otherwise we get a ton of variances.
marco: support burden question — will we need dedicated onboarding sessions? we can do office hours instead of 1:1 to scale.
elaine: proposal: require a single endpoint call using their sample dataset OR a 30 min recorded walkthrough and one office hours session. keeps bar low but gives signal.
leah: legal: need an NDA checkbox for any partner who will share data beyond non-sensitive test data. prefer a standard template link rather than custom docs. also add a clause about anonymized crash logs.
eng-deploy-bot: deployment reminder: dedicated test clusters reserved for dp-preview: dp-priv-01..03 allocated for March window :information_source:
ryan: now for success criteria — draft: (1) 10 active partners with end-to-end integration, (2) median task completion time improvement >= 20% on our eval set for at least 70% of partners, (3) qualitative NPS >= 8 from partner feedback, (4) no critical reliability regressions in X-ray for 2 weeks. thoughts?
priya: can we make the improvement metric optional for early partners? some partners are exploratory and won’t have good evals immediately. maybe tiered criteria A (full integrator) vs B (explorer).
elaine: yes — tier A must meet the numeric metrics, tier B counts for qualitative signals only. we'll aim for 6 A partners + 8 B partners.
sam: to measure regressions we need a baseline perf snapshot per partner (latency, error rate). recommend we capture these during onboarding and store in console under dp-buckets.
marco: support SLA: office hours weekly + shared slack channel. escalation path to SRE for infra issues.
leah: compliance note: if we allow private deployments (VPC/on-prem) during preview we need a checklist for KMS and audit logging before access. add that to onboarding.
elaine: recruitment incentives — two options: (A) free 3 months dedicated capacity, (B) $5k credit + priority support. which drives better commitment?
priya: credits drive signups, dedicated capacity drives deeper technical work. depends on our target cohort. for integrations probably dedicated capacity is better.
ryan: timeline check — recruitment opens next Tuesday, onboarding slots cap at 12 across next 6 weeks. we should publish a short intake form and an integration quickstart.
elaine: I'll draft the intake form (short, 6 questions) and link to a shared sheet. link: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/DP-INTAKE (placeholder). please add fields you want.
sam: add fields for existing infra (cloud, private), expected QPS, and a short sample prompt.
marco: add a checkbox for whether they agree to anonymized telemetry sharing.
elaine: scope negotiation — feature gating for preview: v1 = private endpoint + token-level billing breakdown + basic observability (tail logs + latency). no model training, no multi-tenant caching yet. any strong objections?
ryan: sounds right. hold back advanced routing and canary rollouts until post-preview.
priya: callout: expose a togglable debug flag for partners so we can enable extra logs per partner without noise for others.
leah: also require one documented data retention policy per partner.
elaine: final asks: sam to draft onboarding SDK + quickstart by EOD Thursday, priyato capture the intake form questions, marco to draft office-hours cadence and support channel template, leah to attach NDA template and checklist. we'll sync Friday morning 10am to finalize outreach copy. :thumbsup:
eng-deploy-bot: scheduled message: reminder set for Friday 10:00 AM PT — #product thread follow-up created.
